summary: Detach one or all pipe destinations and preserve flow-state/unpipe event behavior.

target.notes: Detach the specified destination, or all destinations when omitted; emit 'unpipe' on each detached destination as Node requires; return the readable.

caveats: Removing a pipe can leave readableFlowing false; merely adding a data listener afterward does not always restart it until resume().

tests.name: specific unpipe
tests.input: const {PassThrough}=require('node:stream'); const r=new PassThrough(); const w=new PassThrough(); let n=0; w.on('unpipe',()=>n++); r.pipe(w); r.unpipe(w); console.log(n);

tests.name: unpipe unknown destination no-op
tests.input: const {PassThrough}=require('node:stream'); const r=new PassThrough(); const w=new PassThrough(); console.log(r.unpipe(w)===r);
